title: Tactical rollout bulletin and standup prompts — May 2027 (draft)
content:
Purpose:
Quick operational bulletin and a compact set of standup prompts for the next 7-day staggered rollout (May 12–18, 2027). This is a working doc — use it during shift handoffs and paste into the channel daily. Focus: traffic-safe rollout of runtime v1.8.2 + model-routing updates with two-step canary and gradual regional ramp.

Scope / what’s in this rollout
- runtime v1.8.2 (latency-focused kernel switch for long-context ops)
- model-routing policy change: prefer low-cost variant for non-LLM-critical customers, keep high-SLO variant for enterprise tiers
- small config change to prefix cache invalidation logic (to reduce stale responses during model swaps)

Key calendar (UTC) — condensed
- May 12 09:00 — preflight smoke (staging), perf sanity test, canary bundle build complete
- May 12 13:00 — first canary traffic (1% global), 2h watch window
- May 12 15:30 — quick health/latency check and decision gate: proceed to 5% or roll back
- May 13 00:00 — regional ramp begins APAC lanes (staggered: 2% -> 10% over 6h)
- May 14 06:00 — second canary in EU region (5% -> 20% dependent on signals)
- May 15 02:00 — full global ramp gating (up to 50% if SLOs stable)
- May 16 04:00 — cadence: switch remaining traffic after verification (target full by May 18 00:00)

Watchlist (primary signals to monitor) — put these top of dashboard
- 99th percentile token latency (model-gen pipeline) — failure threshold +30% vs baseline
- Error rate for accept/retry (5xx and 429s combined) — failure threshold >0.5% sustained 15m
- Inference tail queue length on dedicated pools — threshold > 50 pending requests per pool
- KV-prefetch miss rate spike — watch for sudden jump >3x baseline
- Cost-per-token delta (observability) — ensure not >15% uplift for hosted customers at canary

Primary rollback triggers (if any one triggers):
- 99p latency > +30% for 10m AND user-visible errors >0.2%
- sustained 5xx surge >0.5% for 10m
- any telemetry showing cache corruption (prefix mismatch alerts)
- automated rollout job fails more than 2 consecutive attempts
- any enterprise customer reports regression via priority support channel (treat as immediate hold)

Rollout steps (operator-facing, shorthand)
1) Preflight (done in staging) — smoke + perf + regression evals (checklist below)
2) Build and artifact pin — note build id: runtime-1.8.2+20270512-rc3
3) Canary step 1: 1% global for 2h (observe, keep chat thread open)
4) Canary step 2: 5% for 3h (if step 1 ok) -> run short synthetic QA prompts against long-context path
5) Regional ramps: APAC then EU then NA (staggered to reduce cross-region blast)
6) Mid-roll verification: run traffic generator for critical customer flows for 30m at 2x usual QPS in the canary pool
7) Final switch: 100% after gating and signoff from on-call SRE + release eng owner

Preflight quick checklist (copy into preflight runbook)
- [ ] Staging smoke green (end-to-end ephemeral env)
- [ ] Perf harness: 95th and 99th metrics within baseline+10%
- [ ] Regression evals: golden prompt set (promptset-id: roll-2027-05-v2) results compared -> no semantic drift > 0.5 BLEU-equivalent metric
- [ ] Canary build uploaded and pinned in artifact store
- [ ] Rollout job configured with fallback variant and max-backoff policy
- [ ] Observability dashboards linked and alerted (pager, slack, pagerduty runbook updated)
- [ ] Customer impact list populated (enterprise customers + reserved capacity IDs)

Standup prompts (use these in #release-ops at each handoff) — paste the compact block: 
"Good morning / evening — Rollout brief: runtime v1.8.2, current phase: <phase>. Key asks: 1) Watch 99p latency and 5xxs, report anomalies, 2) If alerts trigger rollback conditions, call the rollback gate and tag @oncall-sre, 3) Keep handshake with PS for enterprise notices. Current traffic %: <x%>. Active canaries: <regions>. Open actions: <short list>."

Daily cadence template for the bulletin (to copy into confluence or the release digest)
- Day +0 (preflight): summary + build id + staging links
- Day +1 (canary): first canary result + raw metrics snapshot + decision log (proceed/hold/rollback)
- Day +2 (regional): regional ramp table (APAC/EU/NA) + any customer hits noted
- Day +3 (mid-verification): synthetic stress pass + latency heatmaps + anomalies closed
- Day +5 (complete): final state, incident notes if any, follow-ups assigned

Notification templates (short)
- To customers (PS template): "We are performing a gradual platform update May 12–18 to improve long-context latency. You may see very short, low-probability retries while we validate. If you notice anything, please reply to this thread and we’ll escalate."
- Incident hot: "Rollback initiated for runtime v1.8.2 due to elevated 99p latency and 5xxs. We are reverting traffic to runtime-1.8.1 and investigating. ETA for full reversion: ~15m."

Release notes draft (high-level)
- Summary: runtime v1.8.2 — targeted kernel optimizations for long context batches and a safer prefix cache invalidation path. Expected impact: 5–20% improvement in median token latency for >8k token requests; lower p99 variability for mixed-batch workloads.
- Notable changes: kernel-selector tweak, routing policy addition (low-cost variant), cache invalidation small fix.
- Known limitations: small subset of older quantized artifacts may see a slight tokenization edge case. We have a follow-up patch ready (PR #879) if we see customer hits.

Open questions / TODOs (working)
- Confirm whether any dedicated GPU pools owned by partner customers are excluded by default from the routing policy change (Priya to confirm with infra by EOD May 4).
- Decide if we should enable an extra telemetry sample for prefix-cache misses for 48h post-rollout (recommended).
- Add synthetic prompt to long-context suite that exercises model-swap path more aggressively (Marcus).

Action owner list (short)
- Sofia M. — release lead (this doc owner, final go/no-go)
- Priya N. — infra gating and pool exclusion check
- Ethan C. — observability alerts and pagerduty runbook update
- Marcus L. — synthetic QA and golden prompt runner

Notes to self / friction items spotted earlier in the week
- We saw a flaky artifact push yesterday; ensure artifact-store has dedupe checks and retention policy in place for rc builds.
- Quick manual test: run promptset roll-2027-05-v2 against both model variants to capture a side-by-side diff for customers who ask.

Appendix: quick list of links (paste into chat during roll)
- Build artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/runtime/1.8.2/20270512-rc3
- Perf dashboards: https://obs.redwood.ai/dashboards/rollout-2027-05
- PagerDuty runbook: https://pd.redwood.ai/runbooks/runtime-rollout
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/872 , https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/879

If something looks off in the first 30m of each canary window, hold and escalate. Keep the bulletin short and pragmatic — paste the standup prompt at each handover.

-- Sofia
